title: Project Manager

Job Description
The School of Oceanography has an outstanding opportunity for a Project Manager (program operations specialist) to join their team.
About this Opportunity
Working under the supervision of the Director of SEASAM. the SEASAM Project Manager provides administrative oversight of the Seafloor Sampling Facility, serving as a key interface between the scientific and and logistical functions of the facility. Grounded in strong scientific and professional experience with physical seafloor sampling operations, including shipboard characterization and archival, the Project Manager is the first and central point of contact for supported researchers, other facilities (including vessel operations) and vendors. The Project Manager has budget authority and oversees all purchasing for the facility including travel, consumables, maintenance, and repair of equipment. Crucially, the Project Manager leverages their experience to facilitate internal and external communication and oversee scheduling logistics, ensuring facility operations are both effective and efficient.
Key Responsibilities
Cruise Planning 30%:
Serve as the first and central point of contact for the SEASAM Facility, including for researchers preparing proposals, funded Principal Investigators (PI), vessel and other facility operators (e.g., Multidisciplinary Instrumentation in Support of Oceanography (MISO) Facility, National Deep Submergence Facility (NDSF)) that require scientific or operational support from the SEASAM Facility. Track the University-National Oceanographic Laboratory System (UNOLS) Marine Facilities Planner (MFP) to identify funded projects that may need support and initiate PI contact. Set up internal and external meetings and maintain accessible documentation of meeting outcomes. Work with Operations Manager to develop support budgets for external users of the facility and as-required for the National Science Foundation. Bring scientific and logistical expertise to operational decisions regarding equipment and personnel.
Operational and Shipping Logistics 30%:
Utilize operational and logistical expertise to represent SEASAM in UNOLS scheduling meetings as required. Maintain an updated calendar of cruise dates, mobilization and demobilization information, personnel assignments, and synopses of equipment and consumable needs. Work with Operations Manager and Expedition Leads to coordinate shipping and travel related to SEASAM Facility activities. Collate shipping quotes and handle documentation of competition when applicable. Procure over-the-side insurance for equipment as required. Navigate radiation safety use considerations and documentation for shipping of radiation sources required for shipboard operations (e.g., sealed 137Cs source, CT-scanner, portable X-ray sources). Manage shipping and travel bookings for SEASAM equipment and personnel, including return shipping of recovered samples to designated repositories.
Inventory and Consumable Management 30%:
Manage assets and records of physical inventory status and location, both internally and on the UNOLS MFP. Contribute scientific and operational expertise to decisions surrounding equipment maintenance and development priorities. Coordinate with Operations Manager and Expedition Leads in budgeting for consumables, maintenance and repair of equipment. Oversee vendor contracts, including establishment of purchase orders and invoice submissions.
Community Liaison and Workforce Development 10%: Work collaboratively with the Impact Manager, Operations Manager, and Director to facilitate community input, workforce development (PI training, sea-going interns, etc.) and discovery of facility resources and data products. Collate technician post-cruise feedback and documentation on operational experiences to build institutional knowledge of seafloor sampling operations from UNOLS and non-UNOLS platforms.
Other duties as assigned.

title: Total Rewards Manager
description:
Hi! I’m Rachel and I lead People Operations here at Ashby. I recently joined and I’m excited that we're expanding our team! The People Operations Team provides support to Ashby employees through the development and implementation of programs, policies, and services that contribute to a productive and inclusive working environment. We ensure that the work we do aligns with our Operating Principles https://www.ashbyhq.com/blog/culture/ashbys-operating-principles#operating-principles and strengthens the environment we're building at Ashby. Our approach is to do things differently - we prioritize what truly fits our team and enhances how we work together. By embracing creativity and customization, we aim to create a people-first culture that drives both individual and organizational success.

We review all applications, and there isn’t a benefit to applying quickly. Take your time, look at the application questions and please submit before the application deadline! We aren’t able to take calls outside of the interview process, so reaching out to the team won’t push your application forward.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for an experienced Total Rewards Leader to build and own Ashby’s total rewards function through our next phase of growth.

This is both a strategic and hands-on role responsible for how we approach compensation, equity, and benefits globally. You’ll serve as the functional owner for Total Rewards responsible for setting the philosophy, building the infrastructure, and driving execution while bringing the judgment and leadership needed to help us scale the function over time.

Ashby’s Total Rewards philosophy is thoughtful, principled, and intentionally not one-size-fits-all. Compensation approaches may vary by functional area in order to best fit each part of the organization. Total Rewards provides the structure, documentation, guidance, and governance needed to ensure those approaches remain equitable, competitive, and scalable. Across the company, our shared intent is to be competitive in the market and adapt quickly as markets evolve.

In this role, you’ll partner closely with People Ops, Finance, Talent Acquisition, Legal, and functional leaders to design programs that support how Ashby attracts, retains, and rewards exceptional talent. You’ll help us build a more scalable approach to compensation and total rewards while preserving the flexibility that allows different parts of the business to operate effectively.

We’re looking for someone who has built and scaled Total Rewards programs in high-growth VC backed SaaS companies and who is equally energized by philosophy, systems, and execution. You should be comfortable defining direction while also rolling up your sleeves to run analyses, refine tools and processes, support leaders through nuanced decisions, and build the operating foundation for the future.

This role will start as an individual contributor and is expected to evolve into people management as the function scales.

YOU'LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

Building Ashby’s compensation infrastructure

You’ll work closely with founders, executives, and functional leaders to build and evolve Ashby’s compensation foundations globally. This includes compensation bands, leveling alignment, market positioning, review cadences, benchmarking methodology, guidance for offers, promotions, refreshers, and market adjustments, and clearer compensation structure where it is still needed.

You’ll help ensure our approach can support a mix of more mature compensation structures and areas where it is still evolving. You’ll bring structure to ambiguity and create frameworks that are principled, practical, and scalable. You will support leaders in assessing tradeoffs, documenting non-standardized components, and put the right level of governance in place.

Monitoring the market and helping Ashby adapt quickly

You’ll leverage market data, internal data, and external trends to inform compensation decisions across the business.

ABOUT THE COMPANY:
Join ADDENDUM , a global software development and IT team augmentation firm focusing on fintech, banking, and telco industries. Experience tailored benefits, diverse projects with various tech stacks, and opportunities for growth, freedom, and responsibility you desire.
ABOUT THE ROLE:
Whether you're in the heart of Pune or anywhere else, you'll join forces with dedicated professionals in the financial sector, working on exciting projects that are shaping the architecture of our Intellimatch environment and contribute hands-on to development, customization, and automation efforts.
WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING:
As an Intellimatch Architect, you will:

• Design and propose architectural solutions for new and existing reconciliation workflows.

• Lead and drive Intellimatch development efforts, including custom components and backend logic.

• Write and maintain high-quality code, including stored procedures and other custom backend procedures.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams on delivery execution, workflows, and integration points.

• Ensure code clarity, maintainability, and adherence to best practices.

• Contribute to automated testing strategies and frameworks.

• Troubleshoot, optimize, and resolve complex reconciliation challenges.

WHAT WE EXPECT:

• Proven experience as an Intellimatch developer who can actually code - not just configure or consult.

• Hands-on experience developing custom stored procedures and backend components.

• Experience with Intellimatch versions 19+ is highly desirable (we're on 24.3 ).

• Able to propose and shape system architecture decisions.

• Comfortable balancing technical rigor with business requirements

• Developer-first mindset.

WHAT WE OFFER:
Salary ranges are flexible and depend on your experience. This is a B2B contract based position.

At Addendum we believe in personalized benefits packages that cater to your unique passions. Tell us what drives you, and we'll craft a package accordingly. On top of that, heres whats in store automatically:

•
Top Talent Collaboration: Join award-winning teams from different countries.

•
Diverse, Challenging Projects: Break free from the ordinary with dynamic, stimulating work.

•
Epic Team Events: Join us for summer and winter parties and online events.

•
Learning & Development Opportunities : That new tech certificate is just around the corner.

•
Special Celebrations: We love a good shindig for birthdays and project milestones.

So, get your dancing shoes on and come join the fun!
At ADDENDUM , we wholeheartedly reject all forms of discrimination, including but not limited to age, disability, sex, sexual orientation, pregnancy and maternity, race or ethnicity, religion or belief, gender identity, marriage, civil partnership, or any other protected category. We are committed to fostering a culture of equality and inclusion, where every individual has the opportunity to thrive.

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

Product Sales is a team of deep functional and technical specialists who both lead and advise on deals for the most strategically important products in Stripe’s portfolio. Revenue and Finance Automation (RFA) Product Sales is tasked with attacking a $100B market opportunity for back office finance automation across billing, tax, revenue reporting, and data. 

What you’ll do

As a Data Account Executive at Stripe, you will use your sales and product expertise to help drive growth for the Data Products. You will collaborate with the core sales, marketing, product marketing, and product teams to develop deep product and industry knowledge and drive strategic deals. You will be instrumental in leading in depth product discussions with existing and prospective customers - and building and executing against our go to market strategy

• 7+ years of sales or prospecting experience at a technology company and a track record of top performance.

title: Back-End Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Join Pigment: The AI Platform Redefining Business Planning
 
Pigment is the AI powered business planning and performance management platform built for agility and scale. We connect people, data, and processes in one intuitive, feature-rich solution, empowering every team-from Finance to HR-to build, adapt, and align strategic plans in real time.
 
Founded in 2019, Pigment is one of the fastest growing SaaS companies globally. Industry leaders like Unilever, Snowflake, Siemens, and DPD use Pigment daily to make more informed decisions and confidently navigate any scenario.
 
With a team of 600+ across Paris, London, New York, San Francisco, and Toronto, we've raised nearly $400M from top-tier investors and were named a Visionary in the 2024 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Financial Planning Software.
 
At Pigment, we take smart risks, celebrate bold ideas, and challenge the status quo all while working as one team. If you're driven by innovation and ready to make an impact at scale, we’d love to hear from you.
 
 
Our Engineering team
 
Our Engineering team is responsible for developing our SaaS platform and building a comprehensive and user-friendly product. 
 
Pigment engineers participate in the entire application development lifecycle, focusing on design, coding, and keeping the production platform up and running. They can be specialized, but there is no strict separation between the backend and the frontend.
 
We value user-centricity and pragmatism: we choose the most relevant tools for the problem we have to solve, understanding the strengths and constraints of each technology.
 
Our engineering culture also values curiosity, humility, trust, ownership and team spirit.
 
Our technical stack is C# on .NET Core Linux, React, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Google Cloud Platform, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, RabbitMQ and Circle CI.
 
Explore Our Tech Blog:
If you're curious about the kind of challenges our engineering team tackles, our culture and our organization, we invite you to explore ourTech Blog!
About this role
 
Who you are
 
More than knowledge of a specific language or framework, we are looking for great software engineering skills: ability to translate functional requirements into an elegant and simple design, and then deliver the code.
 
We are also looking for engineers who understand the product and the customer's needs in detail and can suggest innovative ideas: in the end, it's all about delivering value to end users.
 
In any case, you have:
Experiences as a software engineer working on a product in production.
Demonstrated experience in infrastructure (Kubernetes, IaC tooling, public cloud) and a drive to help teams work effectively and autonomously.
Proven experience designing object oriented software with languages such as C#, Java, C++, Golang, Rust, Python or Ruby (this list is not exhaustive).
Great team spirit with a problem-solving attitude.
A good dose of humility and the willingness to grow (no matter your seniority!).
 
Folks from underrepresented minorities: science shows that you are less likely to apply if you feel that you don’t have all the necessary prerequisites. If this description matches where you are now or what you'd like to grow into in your next position, we encourage you to apply.

title: Director Analytics Engineering
description:

About 1Password

At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.

If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.

As Director, Analytics Engineering, you’ll lead the roadmap, architecture, and team responsible for the trusted data foundations that power 1Password’s business. You’ll shape how data is modeled, tested, documented, governed, and made available to teams across Marketing, Finance, Product, Analytics, and Data Engineering, while staying close to the technical work when it matters. By building reliable data foundations for Artificial Intelligence (AI), you’ll help advance 1Password’s mission to create a safer, simpler digital future. Reporting to the VP, Data Analytics, this role is remote within the United States and Canada.

How we’re using AI today

- Guide customers on how to get the most out of our tools when developing their own multi-agent unmanned systems, drawing on your own hands-on experience.

- Mentor engineers and share domain knowledge across the Korea team.

- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Aerospa

OpenAI’s Applied AI organization turns our latest model capabilities into products used by hundreds of millions of consumers, developers, and organizations worldwide. Our teams build the product experiences and platform foundations behind ChatGPT, Codex, our API platform, and offerings for businesses, enterprises, educational institutions, and other customers.

Financial Engineering powers how customers purchase, access, and pay for these products. We build the systems behind pricing and packaging, checkout, payments, subscriptions, usage-based billing, credits, entitlements, invoicing, and the broader order-to-cash lifecycle. Our work spans consumer subscriptions, self-serve businesses, sophisticated enterprise agreements, developer usage, and emerging monetization models.

- Bring a product-oriented mindset and care about creating simple, trustworthy experiences for both external customers and internal users.

- Communicate clearly with technical and non-technical partners and enjoy working closely with Product, Finance, Accounting, Operations, Data, and Go-to-Market teams.

- Move quickly and independently in an environment where requirements evolve, priorities compete, and the right solution is not always obvious.

title: Transport Partner Operations Executive - Spain
description:
Got Drive? Join AnyVan as we make moving anything, anywhere miles better and build a career that moves just as fast.

Back in 2009, our CEO Angus saw half-empty vans everywhere and knew there had to be a better way! That's how AnyVan began. He set out to create the world's most efficient logistics technology and help halve the number of wasted miles by filling those empty vans.

Since then we've become the nation's favourite way to move, with over 150k five-star reviews and 5 million customers in the UK and Europe. Our team of 400 AnyVanners across London, Cape Town and Bogota is proving that moving doesn't have to cost the earth by helping save 8,520 tonnes of Carbon each year.

Ejecutivo de logística de operaciones - Bogotá DC.

Nuestro CEO, Angus, notó que muchas furgonetas en las carreteras circulaban medio vacías o completamente vacías en cualquier momento. Así nació AnyVan en 2009, con la misión de crear la plataforma logística tecnológica más eficiente del mundo y ayudar a reducir a la mitad los kilómetros recorridos.

Desde entonces, hemos alcanzado hitos increíbles, incluido asegurar la mayor ronda de financiación para una empresa tecnológica de logística en el Reino Unido, gracias a Vitruvian Partners. Hoy, AnyVan es la empresa más grande y de más rápido crecimiento en el sector logístico, con grandes ambiciones para el futuro.

Gracias a la innovación tecnológica, estamos transformando la experiencia de las mudanzas, reduciendo costos y aportando nuestro granito de arena al planeta para que mudarse no le “cueste a la tierra”.

Qué estarás haciendo:

- Buscar y reclutar nuevos Proveedores de Transporte (TP) para el mercado español.

- Incorporar socios de manera efectiva y asegurarte que sepan cómo usar nuestro portal y nuestra aplicación para acceder, ofertar y completar trabajos.

- Ayudar a capacitar a los socios de transporte para garantizar la prestación de servicios de alta calidad y el cumplimiento de los estándares de AnyVan.

- Mantenerte informado y administrar las listas actualizadas de TP disponibles, sus vehículos, ubicaciones y trabajos que pueden cubrir.

- Gestionar consultas de los TP sobre su cuenta o sobre trabajos que han completado.

- Tareas generales, incluida la verificación de comprobantes de entrega, facturación, precios administrativos y gestión de cargos, etc.

- Garantizar que se cumplan los procesos periódicos relacionados con la gestión de cuentas de TP.

- Monitorear y abordar los problemas de rendimiento de TP que puedan surgir, incluidos puntajes de retroalimentación bajos y problemas de cumplimiento.

- Apoyar a los TP's con consultas relacionadas con el uso de la plataforma/app y la ejecución de trabajos.

- Mantener a las partes interesadas/clientes informados sobre cualquier problema y solución a problemas en sus movimientos.

- Construir relaciones basadas en la confianza: teniendo en cuenta en todo momento la satisfacción de nuestros socios y clientes, y resolviendo problemas de forma rápida y eficaz.

- Asignar trabajo a los socios de transporte de acuerdo con las mejores prácticas, negociando para garantizar la variación más cercana posible al precio establecido originalmente.

- Administrar cotizaciones y negociar con los TP a través de un contacto proactivo para asegurar tarifas favorables y mutuamente beneficiosas para AnyVan.

- Manejar los problemas relacionados con el cumplimiento para reducir las tasas de cancelación y mejorar el rendimiento a tiempo y al máximo.

- Ser el primer punto de contacto para nuestros clientes que experimentan el día, atendiendo consultas, resolviendo problemas y brindando un servicio excepcional.

- Mantener registros de clientes precisos y actualizar la información según sea necesario.

- Colaborar con otros departamentos para garantizar que se satisfagan las necesidades del cliente.

- Garantizar que se cumplan los plazos de entrega, interactuando tanto con los TP como con los clientes cuando surjan problemas y resolviéndolos lo más rápido

Job Description:

Location: India

Role Purpose:

· Define and own the Future State Business Architecture (FSA) for regulatory reporting in the controllership value stream covering:

Capabilities, Services, Processes

· Act as the business representative in the technology and data architecture definition to ensure the Future State Architecture (FSA) supports the value stream objectives

· Support the Value Streams in the detailed design of FSA aligned Capabilities, Services and Processes

· Establish and manage business design governance across the Value Stream

· Ensure exceptions to the defined FSA business architecture are recorded and managed in the Value Stream

Principal Accountabilities and Responsibilities :

· Define, document and maintain the Future State Business Architecture (FSA) for regulatory reporting in the controllership value stream, covering end-to-end capabilities, services and processes.

· Translate Finance strategy, regulatory needs and value stream objectives into a coherent target operating model and business architecture blueprint.

· Ensure the architecture is outcome-led (e.g. control, efficiency, data quality, customer/ service impact) and measurable through agreed success metrics. Business representation into Technology, Data and AI architecture

· Act as the Finance value stream business representative in technology, data and AI architecture forums to ensure solution designs align to the FSA and business outcomes.

· Provide clear business requirements, constraints and priorities to architecture and engineering teams; challenge designs where they don’t meet Finance objectives or create unnecessary complexity.

· Partner with Technology/ Data/ AI architects to ensure consistent definitions for key data entities, lineage, controls, and usage across the value stream. Design support and delivery enablement

· Support value stream teams in the detailed design of FSA-aligned capabilities, services and processes, ensuring traceability from strategy → architecture → delivery backlog.

· Provide architecture input into delivery planning, including epics/features, dependencies, sequencing, and

acceptance criteria.

· Identify cross-domain impacts (process, data, controls, people) and drive resolution with relevant stakeholders.

Stakeholder management and communication

title: Devops Engineer (AWS)
description:
As a DevOps Engineer (AWS) at Particle41 , you will play a crucial role in enhancing our software development and IT operations processes. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in both software development and IT operations, with a focus on automating and streamlining processes to achieve efficient and reliable software delivery for our customers. You will work closely with development and operations teams of our customers to build, deploy, and maintain critical systems, ensuring the reliability and scalability of the customers' infrastructure.
Responsibilities:
Collaboration and Communication:

• Work closely with software developers, system administrators, and other stakeholders to understand the requirements and objectives of projects.

• Collaborate on the design, implementation, and maintenance of continuous integration and delivery pipelines.

• Create and maintain comprehensive documentation for systems, processes, and configurations.

Automation and Tooling:

• Design, implement, and manage automation processes for software build, deployment, and configuration.

• Evaluate, select, and implement tools and technologies to enhance the efficiency of the development and deployment processes.

Infrastructure Management:

• Manage and maintain AWS cloud infrastructure to ensure scalability, reliability, and security.

• Implement infrastructure as code (IaC) using tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, and others.

• Establish and maintain CI/CD pipelines to automate the software delivery process, including build, test, and deployment phases.

Monitoring and Performance:

• Develop and implement monitoring solutions using CloudWatch and other AWS monitoring tools to ensure the health and performance of systems and applications.

• Proactively identify and address issues related to system performance, reliability, and scalability.

Security and Compliance:

• Implement and maintain security best practices in infrastructure and application deployment including IAM, security groups, and VPC configurations.

• Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and company security policies.

Troubleshooting and Support:

• Provide support for development and operations teams, addressing issues related to build failures, deployment problems, and system outages.

• Participate in on-call rotation to respond to and resolve critical incidents.

Qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.

• Experience with AWS services including EC2, ECS, EKS, Lambda, S3, RDS, and CloudWatch.

• Proven experience as a DevOps Engineer or similar role.

• Strong proficiency in scripting languages such as Python, Bash, or Ruby.

• Experience with configuration management tools such as Ansible, Puppet, or Chef.

• In-depth knowledge of containerization technologies, such as Docker and Kubernetes.

• Hands-on experience with version control systems, preferably Git.

• Solid understanding of continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) concepts and tools.

• Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.

• Excellent communication and collaboration abilities. Certified (Current or Expired) in at least one of the following: AWS Solutions Architect Associate, AWS Developer Associate, AWS SysOps Administrator Associate, AWS Solutions Architect Professional, AWS DevOps Engineer Professional

title: Policy Advisor
description:
Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver-The World's Most Experienced Driver™-to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15+ U.S. states.

The Waymo Policy and Government Affairs team has a front seat in this exciting moment in the evolution of autonomous driving technology, transportation and tech policy. Successful navigation of the policy landscape is critically important to deploying and scaling our business. Our team works directly with policymakers and third party groups at the national, state and local levels to help advance transportation policy, educate on the safety benefits of the technology, and advance consumer awareness and acceptance. Internally, our efforts support the innovative work of engineering, product, strategy, and partnerships teams, and we work closely with highly-skilled legal and safety experts.

This role is based in the SF Bay Area and will be based in either the SF or Mountain View offices and reports to the Regional Head of the West

You will:

• Lead regional public policy strategy, legislative advocacy, and regulatory engagement across the San Francisco Bay Area (San Francisco, North Bay, East Bay, and Silicon Valley/San Jose).

• Serve as the primary point of contact for city councils, county boards of supervisors, regional transit authorities, and local Departments of Transportation (DOTs).

• Partner cross-functionally with Public Affairs, the First Responder Ambassador team, and Regional Policy leads to ensure aligned messaging and operational continuity.

• Track, analyze and develop policy positions on relevant  municipal ordinances and regional policy initiatives.

• Represent the company at public hearings, council meetings, community roundtables, and industry coalition working groups.

• Build coalitions with local business associations, civic leaders, and community groups to advance key policy priorities.

You have:

• 5+ years of experience in local government affairs, municipal public policy, or legislative advocacy in the SF Bay Area

• Demonstrated track record of building effective relationships with elected officials, agency staff, and community stakeholders.

• Deep knowledge of Bay Area municipal governance, local legislative processes, and regional transportation/infrastructure agencies.

• Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with experience aligning policy goals alongside operations, comms, and safety team

• Exceptional written, verbal, and public-speaking skills with the ability to distill complex technical issues for civic audiences.

We prefer:

• Background in mobility, autonomous vehicles, micromobility, logistics, or emerging technology policy.

Travel:

• 40% local travel across the greater San Francisco Bay Area for municipal meetings, stakeholder engagement, and community events, with occasional trips to corporate headquarters.

title: Senior Developer Advocate, Social
description:
ABOUT LIVEKIT

LiveKit is building the infrastructure layer for the voice-driven era of computing. Our platform gives developers everything they need to build, test, deploy, scale, and observe agents in production. Founded in 2021, LiveKit powers voice AI applications for OpenAI, xAI, Salesforce, Coursera, Spotify, and thousands of others, collectively facilitating billions of calls each year.

ABOUT THIS ROLE

Most company social accounts talking to developers get ignored - or worse, screenshotted for the wrong reasons. Developers can smell marketing from three timelines away, which means the only way to do this job well is to actually be one of them: someone who reads the model release notes for fun, has opinions about agent frameworks, and knows the difference between a post that earns a reply and one that earns a mute. We're not looking for a social media manager who can learn tech. We're looking for someone deep in the agentic AI world who happens to be exceptional at making the internet care.

You'll thrive as a Senior Developer Advocate if you:

- are obsessed with making the best product for our customers

- are known as the go-to person for tackling tough problems

- work hard and can build and ship fast

- are focused on polish, detail and quality

- are a fast learner, frequently picking up new tips, tricks, and skills

The best way to impress us is with thoughtful ways you'd implement LiveKit, and potentially tinkering with it 😊

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Own LiveKit's voice across X, Reddit, TikTok, LinkedIn, and our blog - writing content that developers find credible, useful, and worth sharing

- Turn product launches into social campaigns that reach and excite developers, from the first teaser to the launch-day thread

- Show up in developer conversations about agentic AI as a real participant, not a brand account doing drive-by engagement

- Keep engagement high and measure what works - impressions, views, comments - and connect it to real developer awareness and adoption

- Work closely with engineering, product, and DevRel to translate what we're building into content that lands

WHO YOU ARE

- You've built or grown a developer audience on social - and you can show the receipts

- You're an exceptional writer who adapts voice and format across platforms without losing the plot

- You're deeply interested in agentic AI and follow the space closely enough to have takes

- You're metrics-minded: you form hypotheses, test them, and let engagement data change your approach

NICE TO HAVE

- A genuine interest in voice AI - or better, you've already built something with a voice agent

- Your own developer following on X, TikTok, or elsewhere

- Experience at an AI or developer-tools company where developers were the audience

- You've deleted a fully drafted post because the joke wasn't quite right - and you'd do it again

OUR COMMITMENT TO YOU

- An opportunity to build something truly impactful to the world

- Contribute to open source alongside world-class engineers

- Competitive salary and equity package

- Health, dental, and vision benefits

- Flexible vacation policy

LiveKit is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any characteristic protected by applicable law. If you require a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact recruiting@livekit.io.

title: Performance Marketing Manager - Remote/Worldwide
description:
Job Position: Paid & Performance Marketing Lead
Company: Pro Coffee Gear
Location: Remote (Anywhere)
Type: Full-time
Reports to: VP of Product & Growth
About Us: Pro Coffee Gear is a fast-growing ecommerce and wholesale distributor of commercial and home espresso equipment. We serve cafés, roasters, restaurants, and serious home baristas with new and refurbished espresso machines, grinders, and accessories from the most respected brands in coffee. We’re building a disciplined, data-driven growth engine - and paid media is a critical part of that foundation.
The Role: We’re hiring a Paid & Performance Marketing Lead to own the strategy, performance, and evolution of paid acquisition at PCG. This role will manage and lead our existing Google and Meta ad agencies, while also setting the roadmap to progressively bring paid media in-house as the business scales.
You will be the single owner of paid performance - accountable for results, agency direction, channel expansion, and long-term capability building.
What You'll Own:
1. Paid Media Ownership & Agency Leadership

• Own overall paid media strategy and performance across Google Ads (Search, Shopping, Performance Max, YouTube) and Meta (Facebook & Instagram)

• Act as the primary owner and point of accountability for external paid media agencies, channel-level strategy and prioritization, and budget allocation and pacing

• Set clear goals, KPIs, and expectations for agencies

• Review performance, challenge assumptions, and approve strategy

• Ensure agency work aligns with PCG business goals, merchandising priorities, and creative and brand standards

• You are not a passive agency manager - you own the outcome

2. Transition from Agency-Led to In-House Execution

• Assess what should remain agency-managed vs brought in-house

• Build a roadmap to reduce agency dependency over time and increase internal ownership of strategy and execution

• Personally execute and optimize campaigns where appropriate

• Define tooling, processes, and documentation required to scale in-house

• Hire or develop additional paid media support as needed

3. Google Ads (Primary Revenue Channel)

• Own Google Ads performance end-to-end, whether executed by agency or in-house: brand, non-brand, and SKU-level search; shopping and feed optimization; Performance Max (with strict controls); YouTube for upper-funnel education

• Partner with merchandising to prioritize SKUs, manage inventory constraints, and support launches, refurbished inventory, and clearance

• Ensure strong alignment between search intent, landing pages, and conversion tracking

4. Meta Ads (Demand Creation + Retargeting)

• Own Meta strategy across prospecting (education-driven, high-intent audiences), retargeting (site, CRM, engagement-based), and product launches and promotional bursts

• Direct creative strategy in partnership with internal creative teams

• Review and approve creative testing plans and results

• Ensure Meta is used to create demand, support high-AOV consideration cycles, and feed lifecycle marketing

5. Channel Expansion & Experimentation

• Own testing and expansion into additional paid channels: Reddit, LinkedIn (wholesale, restaurant operators), affiliate and partner marketing, and influencer whitelisting/paid creator ads

description:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life - or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

As Engineering Manager in Vinted's Platform organisation, you will be responsible for leading a team that shapes how engineers - and increasingly AI agents - build, test, and ship software at Vinted. We are hiring 2 Engineering Managers: one to lead the Developer Portal team, and one to lead the Developer Environments team. Both roles share the same mission: making the use of Vinted's Platform feel like using a product for humans and agents alike.

The Developer Portal team owns the entry point to Vinted's Platform - the place engineers go to discover capabilities, understand ownership and requirements, start and track workflows, and inspect the state of their services across Web UI, CLI, and MCP/agent integrations. It works through federation: capability owners publish through a shared contribution framework, while the team owns the product experience that ties it all together. The Developer Environments team owns the environments where code gets built and verified: on-demand development environments with realistic seed data, isolated sandboxes where multiple autonomous coding agents can work the same repository concurrently, and the paths that let changes move from plan to production with minimal human toil.

Both teams sit at the core of Vinted's AI adoption strategy, which shifts engineers toward architecture and planning while AI agents autonomously implement, test, deploy, and monitor. You will report to Artūras Vedrickas, and work closely with Platform capability owners, the Agentic Platform team, Product Engineers across all domains, and Security.

In this position, you’ll 

• Lead a team of engineers building internal products that hundreds of colleagues and a fast-growing population of AI agents rely on every single day

• Shape your team's vision, scope, and quarterly objectives with your stakeholders, and be accountable for turning initiatives into shipped, adopted outcomes - not just merged code

• Create golden paths so that the common journeys - spin up a service, provision a resource, get a test environment, understand what broke - take minutes of focused effort

• Drive outcomes you can actually measure: journey completion time, self-service rate, how ready our repositories and workflows are for agents to work in them

• Own delivery for your team: spotting dependencies early, clearing obstacles, tracking milestones, and stepping in when the plan meets reality

• Ensure the quality of engineering - sound principles, meaningful SLOs, incidents met with fas

title: Sales Development Representative
description:
We are hiring a phone-first Sales Development Representative to own the front end of the sales process for a regenerative medicine and wellness practice. This person is the first human voice a prospect hears: qualifying inbound leads, setting and confirming appointments, operating the CRM as the single source of truth, following up on seminar and event interest, and filling any downtime with proactive outbound business development. The role begins focused on appointment setting and grows with the account; the right hire has the maturity and sales instinct to eventually lead this function as lead volume scales.
Responsibilities:
● Appointment Setting & Lead Qualification ● Qualify prospective clients by identifying their needs and level of interest, and schedule calls, consultations, or seminar attendance on behalf of the team. ● Apply a working understanding of the sales funnel to separate high-intent prospects from tire-kickers and route opportunities to the right next step. Inbound Lead Follow-Up ● Work warm inbound leads across phone, SMS/chat, and email, responding quickly to inquiries and keeping prospects engaged from first touch to booked appointment. ● Run consistent follow-ups and check-ins to nurture prospects, answer questions, reduce no-shows, and lift appointment-to-consult conversion. CRM Operation (GoHighLevel) ● Operate GoHighLevel as the system of record: log every interaction, update lead and contact information, manage pipelines and follow-up tasks, and keep records accurate and current. ● Use and maintain follow-up sequences, tags, and pipeline stages so no lead goes cold and reporting stays clean. Seminar & Event Follow-Up ● Support recurring seminars and events: confirm registrants, follow up with prospects to gauge and reconfirm interest, qualify attendees, and re-engage no-shows and past registrants for future sessions. Business Development (Outbound) ● Fill available capacity with proactive outbound, including cold calling, to build pipeline and keep the calendar full during periods of lighter inbound volume. ● Represent the brand professionally on every outbound touch and hand qualified interest into the CRM and booking flow. Coordination & Reporting ● Coordinate calendars and appointments so prospects receive timely communication and a smooth booking experience. ● Surface trends, objections, and lead-quality signals back to the team to sharpen messaging and targeting. Volume & Ramp Lead flow will start light as paid campaigns ramp. Expect roughly 40 to 50 outreach touches per week to begin, weighted toward outbound business development and seminar follow-up, then shifting toward inbound qualification and appointment setting as ad-driven volume grows. Comfort operating in both modes is essential. Growth Path This is a build-from-the-ground-up seat. As lead volume and the team expand, the right hire has a clear path to lead the appointment-setting and sales-support function. That means learning the inner workings of the process now, being coachable, and demonstrating the judgment to eventually guide others.
📍 Location: LATAM (Remote) ⚠️ Requirements: Proven experience selling beauty, wellness, or healthcare products, or relevant education in a medical or health-related discipline.

title: Senior Manager, Sales Support - EMEA
description:
AutoStore ™ holds a simple yet powerful vision: to store and move things for everyone, everywhere. Founded in Norway, we've grown into a global technology company. AutoStore uses advanced software to automate and orchestrate order fulfillment. Our goal is to ensure orders arrive faster than ever, with minimal environmental impact. That’s how we help brands exceed customer expectations.
We have more than 1600 systems in nearly 60 countries, and we grow continuously as a community of employees, partners, customers, suppliers, and connected technologies. Automation should make life easier, and by listening carefully to our community, we innovate to meet the industry’s most complex needs. With AutoStore ™, brands gain speed, efficiency, and improved workplaces. And much more floor space.

AutoStore - moving things forward.
The Role:
We’re not looking for someone to simply run Sales Support in EMEA. We’re looking for someone who wants to redefine it.
AutoStore is transforming how the world stores, moves, and fulfills goods. As we scale, we are also rethinking how we support our sellers, partners, and customers through stronger operating discipline, smarter processes, better use of data, and practical AI and automation.
As Senior Manager, Sales Support - EMEA, you will lead the regional Sales Support team, own service performance, and help shape the next generation of the function.
You will have an experienced team, real operational complexity, and the opportunity to make the entire experience simpler, faster, and more effective.
Key Tasks and Responsibilities:

• Your first responsibility is people leadership. You will coach, develop, and raise the performance of the EMEA Sales Support team while building a culture of ownership, responsiveness, quality, and continuous improvement.

• You will ensure a consistently high-quality Sales Support experience across EMEA, from purchase-order intake through booking and execution.

• You will stay close to how work actually happens across requests, purchase orders, cases, approvals, systems, handoffs, and escalations, and continually ask:

• Create simpler, more consistent ways of working for Partners, Sellers, and the Sales Support team.

• Improve ownership, handoffs, knowledge, and self-service.

• Use data to identify recurring issues and improvement opportunities.

• Partner across Sales, Finance, Operations, Supply Chain, IT, and other functions to improve the end-to-end experience.

• Use automation and AI to reduce manual effort and help the team focus on higher-value work.

• Turn what works into scalable practices across EMEA and beyond.

• Make AI and automation practical

• We believe AI will change support operations, but only when it solves real problems.

• You do not need to be a software engineer. You do need to be curious, technically confident, and able to identify where technology can improve speed, quality, visibility, or experience.

• You will help translate business problems into clear requirements and work with technical teams to test, adopt, and scale what works.

• You will stay close enough to the operation to understand how work really happens. That may mean coaching a team member, reviewing SLA performance, helping unblock a critical customer issue, improving a workflow, or testing a new AI-enabled way of working.

• You enjoy making teams better, are comfortable with systems and operational detail, and naturally look for simpler, smarter ways to get work done.

• 5+ years of relevant experience in Sales Support, Commercial Operations, Order Management, Customer Operations, Sales Operations, or a similar environment.

• 3+ years of direct people-management experience, with demonstrated success coaching, developing, and raising team performance.

• Experience leading teams in complex, high-scale, or global commercial organizations.

• A track record of improving operational processes and service performance.
